title: Bouquet Fire ~9.4 mi northeast of us
text:
🔥 Bouquet Fire — about 1,048 acres, ~9.4 mi northeast of Tesoro Highlands (straight-line — farther by road).
Not close, and no evacuation activity for our area — sharing for awareness only.
Live map & status: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
